description: Department of Local Government Eastern Province -  Notice of Summon meeting of Under the local Authorities Elections Amendment Act No 22 of 2012 (Irakkamam Pradeshiya Sabha )
categorisation: The gazette content is a notice summoning a meeting to fill a vacancy for the post of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Irakkamam Pradeshiya Sabha). This is directly related to the electoral process for a local government body, falling under the category of "Electoral processes and related matters" as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). It involves an election schedule and procedure, issued under specific electoral legislation (Local Authorities Elections Ordinance).
